svg.title: Where recycled objects wait
svg.desc: Each thread owns a Stack. Other threads hand objects back through WeakOrderQueues linked from it.

svg.text: Thread 1 pops from elements[]. When it runs out, scavenge() moves handles from these Links back into elements[].

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each other thread appends to its own Link chain, so returning an object needs no lock on the Stack.
